options.desc: The scene cuts to a close-up of Sean Combs, who is now wearing sunglasses and a suit jacket.
The scene cuts to an exterior shot of a building with three uniformed officers standing in front of its entrance.
A laptop sits on a cooling pad, keyboard facing the viewer, with a hand hovering over the keys.
The officer on the right begins to walk toward the building's entrance, while the other two officers remain in place.
The camera focuses on a phone screen showing a video of people in a school setting, highlighting someone wearing blue and white sneakers and carrying a blue lunch bag.
The woman with the red guitar continues to sing expressively in the subway car, her face animated as she strums the instrument.
The phone screen shifts to a new video inside a subway car, where a woman with a red guitar stands and gestures while singing to passengers.

The video on the phone screen transitions to a new scene featuring a man in a red suit and sunglasses, with text overlayed at the top that reads, "POV: You let your cousin build a couch fort at the family gathering.
The vehicle continues moving forward on the road, the tornado's base now appearing even wider and closer.
The tornado's swirling mass of dust and debris now completely obscures the horizon, creating a wall of gray that dominates the view from the vehicle.
A massive, swirling tornado dominates the view ahead, its base churning close to the ground as seen from a vehicle traveling on a straight, empty road.
The tornado's base appears to widen as it moves across the flat terrain, still dangerously close to the road.
The person picks up the phone, revealing they are wearing black and white sneakers, dark stockings with rips, and a gray and white sweater.
The hamster continues moving through the white tube, now with its rear legs fully visible as it exits.
The camera angle shifts to a top-down view, revealing a person kneeling on a dark asphalt surface, with a phone lying on the ground in front of them.
A small, light-brown hamster is seen crawling through a white cardboard tube on a cluttered desk.
The camera shifts to a woman in a gray outfit, laughing and clapping her hands together.
The camera, held at an angle, shows a person in a blue hat and gray jacket stepping off a subway car.
The camera view shifts to a kitchen area, where a person's legs are visible on the right side of the frame.
The camera angle remains low, focusing on the tiled floor where a metal pot and other scattered items sit.
The person on the ground remains motionless, their body still positioned near the pool's edge as the camera maintains its wide, static view of the backyard.
The video opens with a wide shot of a backyard featuring a pool and patio, where a person falls abruptly to the ground.
The person on the ground remains motionless near the pool, but now a small ripple effect is visible on the water's surface, suggesting a recent disturbance.
The person on the ground remains motionless near the pool, and the ripples on the water's surface continue to dissipate.
The hand continues to smooth the gray liquid around the submerged yellow-handled axe head with the trowel, creating a uniform surface.
A hand comes into view, holding white earbuds and placing them into the ears of a white cat with gray markings.
The axe head remains submerged, and the gray liquid appears to be a thin layer spread across a concrete surface.
The yellow-handled axe head remains submerged in the gray liquid, but now a hand holding a trowel enters the frame and begins smoothing the liquid around the axe.

The camera angle shifts dramatically, now pointing upwards from the back seat, showing a chaotic jumble of food items and people inside the car; the man in the patterned shirt is still visible, looking up towards the source of the commotion, while the person in the red jacket is no longer visible.

A man in a white shirt sits in a car, looking slightly disgusted as a large skewer of grilled meat is presented to him; the camera is static, capturing the interaction in a close-up shot from inside the vehicle.

The person in the red jacket continues to lean into the car, while the bunch of bananas is held closer to the camera, partially obscuring the view of the car's interior; the man in the patterned shirt remains visible, looking towards the source of the food being offered.
The camera angle shifts slightly, revealing more of the car's interior and the people holding food, while the man in the patterned shirt maintains a neutral expression, looking down.
The man continues to pull the shopping cart toward the camera, his expression intense as he narrows his eyes.
The man continues pulling the shopping cart, now slightly past the car, and his expression shifts to a slight frown.
The man continues pulling the shopping cart, now looking straight ahead again as he passes the open car door.
The man walks toward the camera, now revealing he wears khaki pants and his beanie is dark gray.
The red car's destructive roll continues, now with the vehicle's front end briefly visible as it tumbles.
The red car continues its high-speed journey, now flipping and rolling erratically across the highway lanes.
The red car continues to flip and roll, now momentarily airborne as it spins.
The clip opens with black text on a dark gray screen reading, "Bro: I'm bored let's watch some Instagram reels.
The man's frown deepens as he stares intently forward, his expression unchanging as the clip ends.
The man is smiling.
The pixelated number "2" vanishes, revealing the man's full face, his eyes still wide with an expression of shock and surprise.
The child lands on a yellow trampoline square, their arms outstretched for balance as they approach a wall with white vertical panels.
The camera tilts upward to show a long, segmented, red-and-white pole being raised by several people in the crowd, with a "Visit Ireland" sign visible in the background.
The clip opens with a close-up of a person's arm and clothing, then quickly transitions to a wide shot of a crowd cheering beneath a stadium sign that reads "Press the Great.
The segmented pole continues to rise, now extending higher into the stadium, with the "Visit Ireland" sign still prominently displayed.
The camera focuses on a group of people in the stadium stands, their arms raised in continued cheering.
The hands continue to lift the large, cream-colored object higher, revealing more of the gray and white patterned surface beneath.
The camera pans up to reveal a full view of a cream-colored bed frame with a mattress, set against a white wall with floral wallpaper near the ceiling.
The camera's rapid pan concludes, revealing the full extent of the empty room with light pink flooring and white walls, now also showing a large window with a white frame on the far wall.
The man in the car appears to be looking up and to his right, with a neutral or slightly curious expression on his face.
The camera focuses on the person's face, revealing a serious expression as they look slightly off-center, still wearing the same tattered light-green clothing.
The scene shifts to a desert landscape, viewed from the perspective of a vehicle-mounted weapon pointed down a long, straight road.
The scene abruptly shifts to a dimly lit interior where a person in tattered light-green clothing stands with their midriff exposed.

The video begins with a close-up of a laptop keyboard, its keys black and outlined with a faint purple glow, set against a backdrop featuring a white door and a shelf adorned with Dragon Ball Z figurines.
The scene opens in a dimly lit room where a man with a goatee and a distinctive red-lined collar stands behind a table covered in glowing, intricate designs.
The man's gaze shifts slightly to his left as his expression turns more serious.
The strands of light fade as the man in the red-lined collar lowers his hand further, and the younger man in the green shirt continues to watch with a concerned expression.
The man in the red-lined collar clasps his hands together, then raises them in front of his chest in a crossed position.

The woman's expression shifts to one of surprise or shock as her mouth opens slightly, and her eyes widen, still fixed on something in the distance; the camera zooms in tighter on her face, blurring the background of smoke and debris.

A woman with red hair, wearing a dark tactical suit, stands in a field with smoke rising in the background, her expression serious as she looks to the left; the camera slowly pans to follow her gaze across the open landscape.
The man in the red and black suit pivots to his left, now facing forward, as he raises a large rifle; the weapon is dark and bulky, contrasting with the metallic gray of the control room's walls.

The woman in the tactical suit raises her arm, fist clenched, as she continues to look intently towards something off-screen; the camera angle shifts slightly, revealing more of the smoky, war-torn field and a piece of wreckage to her left.
The perspective shifts abruptly to a ground-level view between two moving buses, their sides vividly colored with pinks and purples.
A person sits at a desk with a keyboard and mouse, with Dragon Ball Z figurines visible on a shelf behind them.
Spider-Man and Spider-Gwen continue to swing upside down through the animated cityscape, maintaining their parallel trajectory.
Spider-Man, now in a black suit with red accents, swings into view on a web line alongside Spider-Gwen, who is also suspended upside down.
A person's hand opens a dark gray laptop with orange accents and glowing orange lines on the back.
The camera focuses on a cockpit display showing "PLANET DESTROYED" and "POPULATION: 14,000,000" in bright green text.
The camera shifts to the Mandalorian in the cockpit, still holding Grogu, whose face is lit by a bright green light.
The camera focuses on Grogu, who is being held by the Mandalorian, as he uses the Force, his face illuminated by a green glow.
The camera angle shifts to reveal a hand lifting the laptop screen, and a man with tousled hair and a black shirt appears in the frame.

The man continues to speak while looking directly at the camera, and the lower third of the screen now displays the words "ORIGINAL SERIES STREAMING" in a stylized font against a dark, swirling green background.
The camera zooms in slightly on the dark gray laptop, keeping the stylized logo centered in the frame.
The video begins with a close-up of a closed, dark gray laptop featuring a stylized logo in the lower center, set against a blurred background with figurines on a shelf.
The scene shifts to a highway overpass, where Spider-Man stands amidst wrecked cars and billowing smoke.
The camera cuts to a crowd of people, with Zendaya at the center, looking concerned.
The scene abruptly shifts to a bright, blue, CGI-rendered explosion of light and energy.
A CGI-rendered Spider-Man figure falls rapidly through a cityscape, viewed from an inverted angle.
The screen fades to black, then displays the title card for "Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness," with "Marvel Studios" appearing above the title in smaller font.

The scene shifts to a dimly lit environment where a woman with long hair and what appears to be a headpiece looks to the side with a concerned expression, while a blurry figure stands behind her near a flickering flame.

The clip begins with a close-up of a gray laptop bearing a reflective logo, positioned to the left of the frame, while a person's arm and part of their torso are visible to the right as they type on a keyboard.
The scene abruptly transitions to a bright, abstract animation featuring swirling, neon blue and white light patterns that fill the entire frame.
The character with spiky black hair and a white cape is replaced by a red and yellow explosion, which then gives way to the 'Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero' title card against a blue background.
The blue car persists on its course, and the camera angle remains consistent, keeping the focus on the driver and front passenger.
The clip begins with a red, triangular warning symbol on a black screen, which quickly transitions to a golden title card featuring Japanese text.
The golden title card with Japanese text fades out, transitioning to an animated scene featuring a blue car with three characters inside.
The scene changes to a medium shot of a man resembling Marlon Brando dressed as Thanos, seated on a golden throne against a backdrop of planets and stars.
The scene transitions to a close-up of the Marlon Brando-Thanos character, now standing against a backdrop of mountains, water, and a sky with two moons.
The clip opens with a close-up of a man in a Thor costume, complete with a helmet and red cape, standing in an ornate, golden room.
The scene abruptly shifts to a close-up of a man resembling David Bowie in a Doctor Strange costume, complete with a high-collared cape, against a backdrop of blurred city lights and crowds.
The scene abruptly cuts to a woman with long, auburn hair walking towards the camera in a futuristic corridor with gray walls and blue lighting.
The woman continues walking, now positioned in front of a large control panel filled with illuminated screens and buttons, suggesting a command center.
The woman's forward movement continues, and the background behind her shifts from the blue-lit command center to a cityscape with tall buildings and blurred traffic.
Clint Eastwood's face remains visible, but the camera zooms out slightly to reveal more of the bar interior, including other patrons and the warm glow of the lighting.
The camera remains in the high, overhead position, showing the man lying motionless on his back in the dirt, with blood still visible on his body and around the wooden structure.
The masked man suddenly grabs the other man by the head and pulls him up, now standing near the doorway of the wooden structure.
The masked man stands over the other man, who is now lying on his back in the dirt, kicking his legs in the air.
A man in a hockey mask violently grabs another man by the shoulders near a wooden structure, both figures are set against a dark, wooded backdrop.
The camera shifts to a ground-level perspective, looking out between the legs of horses and the red robes of the men, revealing a courtyard filled with fallen bodies.
Mounted soldiers charge forward, their horses kicking up dust as they approach a grand building with a waiting carriage.
The mounted soldiers continue their charge, now passing a line of men in red robes and hats who stand at attention.
The mounted soldiers continue their charge, and a man in a red cape and ornate armor stands beside the carriage, drawing his sword.

The camera shifts back to the chaotic field, where the central figure in white and gray continues to battle soldiers in red uniforms amidst explosions and flying bodies; the scene is filled with smoke and debris as the conflict intensifies.
The camera pans to the right, revealing soldiers in green uniforms firing rifles from behind a wooden barricade, while smoke billows from a cannon in the background.
The camera tracks a central figure in white and gray amidst a chaotic battle scene, where soldiers in red uniforms charge forward with bayonets and swords.
The central figure in white and gray stabs forward with a hidden blade, felling a red-uniformed soldier who collapses into the tall grass.
The character pulls down on the bar, and the large door begins to open, revealing a dark passage beyond.
The character approaches the large door and reaches up to grab a horizontal bar, preparing to open it.
The camera pans slightly to the right, revealing a stone platform with two chests, one glowing green and the other red, sitting near a flickering torch.
The character moves from the chests toward a large, ornate door, passing a torch mounted on a stone pillar.
The camera continues its slow pan upwards, now focusing on a large, spiraling metal structure with glowing embers floating around it.
The camera continues its upward pan, revealing more of the spiraling metal structure and the glowing embers that drift around it.
The camera pans slightly to the right, revealing a second brazier with a flame burning atop a stack of books.
The camera continues its upward pan, now revealing a large statue holding a lantern.
The scene opens with a blurred first-person perspective, quickly resolving into a chaotic arena filled with red and purple lighting.
The camera continues its frenetic movement through the arena, the weapon still prominent in the foreground as the player navigates the chaotic environment.
The camera's rapid movement continues through the arena, with the weapon still visible in the lower right corner.
The camera's frantic motion continues, now focusing on enemies in the arena, with the weapon still visible in the lower left.
The woman is now face-to-face with a humanoid figure covered in ice and snow, its eyes open and face frozen in a grimace.
The woman continues walking through the snowy, mountainous terrain, now passing between large rocks.
The woman, now seen from behind, stumbles forward after apparently falling, her backpack visible.
The camera focuses on a woman with a braid and a dark beanie, standing in a snowy, mountainous landscape.
The woman walks through the room, which is now illuminated by a flashlight, and stops in front of a counter with blood splattered on the wall behind it.
A woman in a green jacket and blue jeans is in a dimly lit, dilapidated room with blood splattered on the floor; she is straddling a body and repeatedly punching it.
The woman stands up and grabs a brown bottle, then turns to face a zombie that has entered the room; she swings the bottle at the zombie, then grabs it and stabs it repeatedly with a knife.

The woman walks toward a window with a view of a snowy outdoor scene, then climbs through it and drops to the ground outside; two zombies are visible in the snow-covered area, and the woman crouches to avoid being seen.
Dina holds the videotape and looks at Ellie, who is still holding the gun.
Ellie holds a gun as Dina picks up a videotape from a shelf, and they exchange glances while examining it.
Dina continues to hold the videotape, now looking down at it with a smile as Ellie also looks down, her gun still in hand.
Ellie struggles with a jar, then Dina takes it from her hands, looking down at it with a slight smile as she attempts to open it herself.
The woman on the wall continues to play the guitar, her fingers strumming the strings, while the woman on the ground remains seated, her gaze steady.

The woman on the wall continues to play the guitar, her fingers strumming, while the woman on the ground remains seated, still watching her; the camera angle shifts slightly, offering a closer view of the guitarist's face as she sings.
The woman on the wall continues to play the guitar, her fingers now moving up and down the fretboard as she sings, while the woman on the ground maintains her gaze, a soft smile playing on her lips.

A woman with dark hair sits on the ground, looking up at another woman who is sitting on a low wall and playing an acoustic guitar; the guitarist strums the strings and sings, her fingers moving along the fretboard as she focuses on her playing.
The woman who previously had her eyes closed now opens them, her gaze still directed downward, while the other woman maintains her bowed posture, her expression unchanged.
The woman with the ponytail remains bowed, while the other woman's expression shifts slightly, her eyes now closed as if in resignation.
The woman with the ponytail lifts her head and looks at the other woman, her expression shifting to one of concern, while the other woman sits up on a tufted couch, tears streaming down her face.

Two women stand in a dimly lit, cavernous space with textured walls; one woman with a ponytail looks down with her head bowed, while the other, standing upright, gazes downward with a somber expression and a visible backpack strap.
The clip opens in a dark, fantastical setting, revealing a hulking, armored figure wielding a spiked hammer, surrounded by smaller, goblin-like creatures.
The scene shifts to a new environment, revealing a character holding a torch in a misty, wooded area.
The armored figure, now revealed to be an Orc, raises a double-bladed axe high above his head as the camera pans out to show a wider view of the encampment under a starry night sky.
The Orc continues to hold his axe aloft, unmoving, as the camera begins a slow zoom.
The camera rapidly shifts to a rider on a large reptilian beast charging through a forest, followed by scenes of soldiers clashing in close combat.
The armored figure extends a hand, conjuring a swirling blue energy; the perspective shifts to show soldiers with spears and shields, then focuses on a soldier whose shield is pierced by arrows.
The camera zooms in on the staff, now emitting a bright lightning-like energy, before cutting to a close-up of a figure in golden armor and an elaborate helmet standing in a forest.
The scene opens with a group of figures in ornate robes and pointed hats standing in a dark, cloudy environment, each holding a staff topped with a glowing blue light.
The camera rapidly shifts to a rider on a large reptilian beast charging through a forest, followed by scenes of soldiers clashing in close combat.

The camera zooms in on the staff, now emitting a bright lightning-like energy, before cutting to a close-up of a figure in golden armor and an elaborate helmet standing in a forest.
The clip opens with an aerial view of a fantastical world featuring varied terrains and a swirling vortex structure in the distance.
The camera continues its aerial movement, now revealing names of regions and straits overlaid on the landscape, such as "Western Straits of the Great Ocean" and "Estalia.

The camera continues its rapid aerial movement, now focusing on a winged creature with a rider, then transitioning to a large, grotesque figure adorned with tribal ornaments and seated on a throne made of tusks.
The camera rapidly flies over varied landscapes, transitioning from a dark forest with humanoid figures attacking a large creature to aerial views of islands and continents.
A gloved hand presents a crown with icy blue spikes, illuminated by candlelight in a dim space.
The scene shifts to a snowy battlefield where armored figures clash with red-skinned demons wielding fiery swords.
The camera pans up to reveal a massive, horned beast falling to the ground amidst the snowy chaos, its silhouette stark against the white sky.
The camera focuses on ice shards forming on the snowy ground, then pans up to reveal a woman in regal attire, complete with the icy crown, extending her arm as if casting a spell.
The clip opens with a group of ogre-like figures, one wielding a flaming hammer, standing amidst rocky terrain.
The ogre-like figure explodes in a burst of orange and red energy, then the camera pans to a field where a large fire erupts amidst the tall grass.
The camera pans across a desolate landscape to reveal a lone figure walking towards towering statues in the distance.
The ogre-like figures continue their charge across the rocky terrain, some engulfed in flames as they advance.
The scene transitions to a black screen displaying the logos for SEGA and Total War.

The camera focuses on a large, pink foot standing on a ground littered with bones and rocks, then pans up to reveal a yellow-green ogre-like creature with a chain around its neck, holding a bone club.
The ogre-like creature raises its bone club, revealing a second, similar but smaller, green-blue ogre behind it.
The video opens with a red, armored figure holding two axes aloft, electricity crackling around them, in front of a dark, castle-like structure under a pink and purple sky.
The video opens with a wide shot of a crowd of armored figures, then cuts to a table where a group of bearded characters are seated, scrolls laid out before them.
The scene shifts to a battlefield where armored figures clash amidst smoke and fire, their movements rapid and chaotic.
The camera pans across a battlefield littered with bodies, focusing on a warrior adorned with skulls, his sword drawn amidst the ongoing conflict.
The scene shifts to a towering, horned demon standing amidst a fiery landscape, its muscular form and menacing presence dominating the frame.
Three men in hats and western wear burst through a brick doorway, guns drawn, into a dusty outdoor area with mountains in the distance.
One of the men is now on the ground, being straddled and punched repeatedly by another man who is holding a rifle.
The camera shifts to an overhead view of a man lying in an open grave, complete with a headstone.
The man on the ground is no longer being punched, and he is now kneeling while two of the other men stand over him.
The older man stands in front of the window, looking down with a slightly furrowed brow as if in thought or concern.
The older man sets the eyeball down on a small table, then turns and walks toward a window, while the younger man remains still.
The younger man with the rifle now stands directly beside the older man, both looking off-screen to the left.
An older man in a tattered hat holds up a detached eyeball, while a younger man with a rifle slung over his shoulder enters the room.
The camera shifts focus to the man with the mustache and scarf, who is now flanked by the man in the cowboy hat and the man in the sombrero.

The camera pulls back to reveal the man with the mustache and scarf is flanked by the man in the cowboy hat and the man in the sombrero, who stand motionless as the man with the mustache and scarf begins to move his arms and speak.
The camera focuses on a man in a cowboy hat as he speaks to another man with a mustache and a scarf; a third man in a sombrero stands nearby.
The man with the mustache and scarf walks away from the other two men, then pulls out a gun and shoots the man in the cowboy hat, who falls to his knees.
The girl walks further into the room, and the camera angle shifts slightly to reveal a door and a glimpse of another room with a white chair and a poster on the wall.
The man pulls out a gun and holds the girl close as they both look toward the sliding glass doors, where bloody handprints are now visible on the glass.
The man shoots at a zombie that has entered the room, and it falls to the floor, leaving a trail of blood on the rug as the man grabs the girl's arm and pulls her toward another room.

A young girl stands inside a dimly lit house, looking out through sliding glass doors at a dark, rainy night, then turns to walk toward an open doorway; inside the room beyond, a man stands near a desk illuminated by a lamp, and he turns to face the girl as she enters.
The abstract black and white background continues to shift slightly as the text changes to "CHRISTIAN NAKATA" and identifies him as the LEAD ENVIRONMENT ARTIST.
The clip opens with a black and white abstract background, resembling ink blots or splatters, as text appears identifying "MIKE YOSH" as the LEAD GAMEPLAY ANIMATOR.
The abstract black and white background continues to shift and morph, now revealing the text "WILLIAM JAMES" identifying him as the LEAD WRITER.

The abstract black and white background fades to black before a dimly lit scene appears, showing a man sitting in front of a window with blinds, as the text "20 YEARS LATER" appears at the bottom of the screen.
The man and woman crouch behind a low wall, then the man moves forward to peer over it, drawing a handgun.
The man fires his handgun at a red can on a wooden table, causing a burst of flame.
The man continues to fire his handgun, now at a second man who is running toward him in a crouch.
The camera faces a woman with a backpack as she faces three men, one of whom gestures aggressively while speaking.
The man and woman move forward from behind the concrete wall, now walking through a dark, dilapidated trench-like area with a building visible in the distance.
The woman and man continue to run through the dilapidated, rain-soaked environment, now navigating under a large pipe and past concrete structures.
The woman ducks down behind a low concrete wall, and the man follows, crouching to stay out of sight as they move toward a doorway blocked by rubble.
The woman sprints away, and the man follows, his face tense as he navigates the dilapidated environment.
The man stands up, now holding a gun, and aims it toward a doorway where two figures are visible in the distance.
A man with blood on his face and arms is bent over another person, his hands gripping their neck as the camera angle shifts slightly.
The man continues to strangle the person beneath him, but the camera now shows the victim's face, revealing a bloody and disfigured appearance.
The man continues to swing his melee weapon, striking the second zombie-like figure as the camera follows his movements.
The camera follows a man with a backpack and rifle slung over his shoulder as he walks through an overgrown, dilapidated town, passing rusted vehicles and brick buildings.
The man is pulled through a window by another person, and they both fall to the ground, covered in dust.
The woman who pulled the man through the window is now inside the building, looking through the window at the man as he gets up off the ground.
The man is now inside a building, where he is suddenly attacked by a grotesque, fleshy creature that climbs over him.
The character continues moving through the building, now with a backpack and a long weapon strapped to it.
The scene opens under a makeshift awning, revealing a character aiming a pistol from behind cover, his arm extended and the weapon steady.
The character swaps the pistol for the long weapon strapped to the backpack, then moves forward and shoots an enemy on a couch.
The character ducks behind cover, then moves forward, pistol still raised, into a building with a large mural near the ceiling.

Tom Holland, still bloodied, continues to look off to the side with a determined expression, while the camera then cuts to a close-up of Willem Dafoe, who is smiling maniacally against a backdrop of fiery wreckage.
Tobey Maguire remains lying down, his expression shifting slightly as he looks upward.
The camera shifts to a close-up of Tom Holland, whose face is marked with blood and dirt as he looks intensely to the side.
The camera cuts to a medium shot of a bloodied Tom Holland, then to a close-up of a man with wide eyes, and then to a shot of Tobey Maguire.
Spider-Man remains injured but now stands, looking toward Doctor Strange, who appears grim against a backdrop of swirling purple energy.
The three Spider-Men break from their embrace, and the youngest expresses his gratitude, his voice cracking with emotion as he looks up at the other two.
The camera pulls back to reveal three Spider-Men standing on a piece of wreckage, with a city skyline visible in the distance across the water.
The clip opens with a close-up of a visibly injured Spider-Man, his suit torn and face bruised, as he looks off-screen with a slightly dazed expression.
The camera zooms out slightly, keeping the three young men in their red and gold suits centered in the frame as they continue their discussion under the same dim lighting.
The three young men in red and gold suits swing from cables against the backdrop of a brightly lit cityscape at night.
A young man in a red and gold suit speaks with visible frustration, his face illuminated against a dark background.
The young man in the red and gold suit smiles slightly, then the camera cuts to the three young men running along a metal structure towards a cityscape at night.

A man with a beard sits at a table with a glass of milk and dominoes, while a younger man in a dark uniform stands near a window, holding what appears to be a pair of glasses or a small case.
